purpose: ensure T and TN differ in planning semantics, not visible donor metadata or provenance

semantic_fields.cast: array of character/function/participation semantics with provenance stripped
semantic_fields.event: string copied from sealed semantic packet
semantic_fields.info_shift: array with subject/before/after/mode and target-relative scene_slots; provenance stripped
semantic_fields.plant_payoff: array with kind/statement and target-relative scene_slots; thread/provenance IDs stripped
semantic_fields.scene_notes: ordered target-relative slots with functional_propositions only

TN_materialization.semantic_source: frozen cyclic +1 donor within same work from prereg v1.0
TN_materialization.empty_target_slots_policy: explicit empty functional_propositions; never fill with target semantics

validity_rule: any result exposing donor identity or explicit mismatch label to renderer is INVALID_CONTROL_PRESENTATION
